_comment: Window = pre-attack slack (lingering/loitering before the strike). A 25-min
window assumes the attacker arrived early and waited at the lake -- relevant
to the faire scenario: if he left China Camp by ~16:30 and got to the lake
well before 18:15, the slack absorbs the wait. Watch the combined map: the
feasible zone grows, and towns' comb values drop ~10 min.
NOTE: changing a scene's window rebuilds that field (seconds) + the pieces
(~1-2 min) on first run; later identical tests reuse the cache.
